description: Look up official term definitions from Belgian legislation. Uses partial matching: "données" matches "données à caractère personnel". Returns the defined term, its definition text, and the source provision. Optionally filter to a specific statute. Use this to find legal definitions before interpreting legislation.

document_id.description: Optional: filter to definitions from a specific statute.

term.description: Term to look up (e.g., "données personnelles", "traitement"). Partial matching supported.

name: get_definitions
